about_the_game:
In MegaFactory Tycoon, you are the manager of a fully automated factory.
The factory produces consumer products that can be sold for profit on the central market.

You decide the factory layout, place production machines and connect them with conveyor belts.
You also set up the logistics for trucks to transport consumer products to the central market and return with raw materials for additional production.
Eventually you will also be able to create blueprints for common layouts, allowing you to expand even quicker by placing an entire group of machines and belts in a single action.

As you reach certain milestones, you will unlock technologies that allow you to produce new and more advanced products, for even greater profit.

As you expand your factory, you will eventually reach its limit in size, but it does not end there.
You can purchase additional empty factories and fill them with machines as well.
Advanced quantum technology innovations let you efficiently teleport items between factories. One factory can produce intermediate products for another factory to use as input.

Every factory is fully simulated in real-time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-9100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or equiavalent
  • Storage: 100 MB available space

  • OS: Windows 11

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or equiavalent
